title: Pale Scepter Staff
html:
Source not yet observed

How to get it

Unique. Dropped by Morvaine the Pale on 2% of kills (10% from an elite). Built on Black Walnut Staff; bound, so it can’t be traded. Unique items can’t be reforged.

  • A kill restores 10% of your maximum mana. An attack or spell that kills several monsters restores it once.
  • Counts as a 6 carat staff enchant for spells of every school.

See Unique items for all of them.

No monster drops recorded for this item.
